description: Quality-first ranking rework (Part C), global to RSS and X. Folds engagement + corroboration into the existing 10-weight budget (recency weight -> 0, applied LAST as a bounded [0.95,1.0] multiplier), max age 24h (configurable up to 36h), adds the 8 new LLM judgement fields, the X hard-filter branch, the pre-scoring CorroborationContext, relative-engagement + corroboration component math, the verified/high-risk gate, the views-only tiebreak, the prompt + few-shot updates, and the score.test.ts fixture update. Incorporates FIX #2 (read item.isOfficialAccount directly), #3 (shared groupTextKey + required accountStatus), #4 (canonical urlKey with lowercased host + mixed-case handling), #5 (85 uncorroborated cap documented, not reweighted), #7 (views tiebreak path), #14 (update all 6 few-shots in the same edit). Depends on FEAT-001 (metadata fields postToRaw stamps) and FEAT-002 (accountStatus/isOfficialAccount/accountCredibilityScore on saved items). Independent of FEAT-004 until payload wiring.
steps: src/mastra/config/ranking.config.ts — maxAgeHours = Math.min(envNum('RANK_MAX_AGE_HOURS',24),36) with a maxAgeCeilingHours 36 field. Drive weights.recency to 0.0 and redistribute so weights still sum to EXACTLY 10.0: significance 2.5, topicFit 2.0, audienceInterest 1.5, visualPotential 1.0, coverage 0.75, sourceCredibility 0.75, recency 0.0, engagement 1.0 (NEW), corroboration 0.5 (NEW). Keep recencyHalfLifeHours (used by the existing recencyScore unit test). Add recencyTiebreaker: { minMultiplier: 0.95, maxMultiplier: 1.0 }. Add an `x` block: minEngagementFloor 20, minTextLength 60, engagementRatioCap 3, neutralEngagementRatio 1, minSamplesForMedian 3, viewsBonusMax 0 (FIX #7 — views contribute 0 points, break ties only), corroborationRssShare 0.6, corroborationMultiAccountShare 0.4, claimRiskHighPenalty 15, allowUnverifiedHighRisk (RANK_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_HIGH_RISK, default false). All env-overridable + conservative. Update the header comment's weight-budget note to include the two new 0-10 components.

src/mastra/schemas/ranking.ts — extend LlmScoreSchema with 8 REQUIRED fields: isNewInformation z.boolean(), isPrimarySource z.boolean(), specificity 0-10, hookPotential 0-10, claimRisk z.enum(['low','medium','high']), flags z.object({engagementBait,selfPromotion,giveaway,hotTakeThread} booleans), derivedHeadline z.string().max(200), headlineDerived z.literal(true). Extend ScoreComponentsSchema with qualityScore, engagementComponent, engagementRatio, corroborationComponent, recencyMultiplier, recencyAdjustment. Extend RankedStorySchema with qualityScore z.number().min(0).max(100) and optional derivedHeadline/hookPotential/claimRisk/verified/outboundUrls/quoted/attributionLine/blockedUnlessOverride. FIX #2/#3 extend RankInputItemSchema with optional X fields: isX?, isReply?, isRepost?, outboundUrls?, quoted?, authorHandle?, engagementRaw?:{likes,reposts,replies,views}, accountMedianLikes?, accountMedianReposts?, accountStatus?: string (defaulted 'candidate' at the mapper), isOfficialAccount?: boolean, accountCredibilityScore?: number, and the carried LLM meaning fields needed by scoring (isPrimarySource?, claimRisk?, derivedHeadline?, hookPotential?).

src/mastra/lib/ranking/hardFilter.ts — add drop reasons X_IS_REPLY_OR_REPOST, X_BELOW_ENGAGEMENT_FLOOR, X_NO_SOURCE_SHORT. Branch on item.isX: for X items SKIP SUMMARY_TOO_SHORT; drop if isReply || isRepost; drop if (likes+reposts+replies) < config.x.minEngagementFloor (read from item.engagementRaw); drop if outboundUrls.length===0 && item text/summary length < config.x.minTextLength. FIX #7: keep too_old (on publishedAt, config.maxAgeHours) as the SINGLE source of truth for the 24h drop, applied to X items too. Leave ALL existing RSS filters unchanged (NFR-3).

src/mastra/lib/ranking/rankStories.ts — add a pre-scoring stage AFTER Stage B (LLM scoring) and BEFORE the computeRankedStory map that builds CorroborationContext { rssUrlSet: Set<string>; credibleAccountsByGroup: Map<string,number> } from the `kept` list (no gateway call). FIX #4: define ONE canonical urlKey(u) = a small wrapper over normalizeUrl(u) that LOWERCASES the host; build rssUrlSet = new Set(kept.filter(i=>!i.isX).map(i=>urlKey(i.url))). FIX #3: define ONE shared pure groupTextKey(text) = text.toLowerCase().normalize('NFKC').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu,'').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,12).join(' '); credibleAccountsByGroup groups X items by the first shared signal (any shared normalized outbound-URL host, else groupTextKey) and counts distinct authorHandle whose accountStatus==='promoted'. Inject CorroborationContext into ScoreContext and pass it into every computeRankedStory call. Export urlKey and groupTextKey (and the matchOutboundToRss helper) so FEAT-005's corroboration.test.ts can target them.

src/mastra/lib/ranking/score.ts — restructure computeRankedStory to compute qualityScore FIRST then finalScore. qualityScore = clamp(Σ wᵢ·componentᵢ + regionBalanceAdjustment − penalties, 0, 100), where components now include: a pure relativeEngagement(engagementRaw, accountMedianLikes, config) -> { ratio, component } (ratio = clamp((likes+reposts+replies)/max(accountMedianLikes,1),0,engagementRatioCap) when the account has >=minSamplesForMedian samples inferred from a non-zero accountMedianLikes, else neutralEngagementRatio; component = clamp(ratio/engagementRatioCap*10,0,10) plus at most viewsBonusMax tenths when views present — default 0 so no effect; RSS engagementComponent = 0); a pure corroborationComponent(item, ctx, config) -> 0-10 (corroborationRssShare*10 when matchOutboundToRss(item.outboundUrls, ctx.rssUrlSet) via urlKey host/full match; plus corroborationMultiAccountShare*10 when ctx.credibleAccountsByGroup.get(groupKey)>=2; clamp 0-10; the clusterId-equality branch is DROPPED entirely); recencyScore with weight 0 (kept for the breakdown). FIX #2: verified = item.isOfficialAccount || llm.isPrimarySource || outboundPointsToPrimary || corroboratedByRss (read item.isOfficialAccount directly — do NOT recompute from account fields). FIX #5: add a code comment that a maxed UNCORROBORATED RSS item caps at ~85 (engagement 0) and only reaches ~90 when cross-corroborated — INTENTIONAL and acceptable because it still clears default minScore 55; do NOT reweight. If (!verified && claimRisk==='high') add config.x.claimRiskHighPenalty and set blockedUnlessOverride=true. Apply the recency tiebreaker LAST: recencyMultiplier = minMultiplier + (maxMultiplier-minMultiplier)*clamp(1-age/maxAgeHours,0,1); finalScore = round2(qualityScore * recencyMultiplier); recencyAdjustment = finalScore - qualityScore. Populate every new ScoreComponents/RankedStory field (qualityScore, engagementComponent, engagementRatio, corroborationComponent, recencyMultiplier, recencyAdjustment, verified, blockedUnlessOverride, derivedHeadline/hookPotential/claimRisk/outboundUrls/quoted where present).

src/mastra/lib/ranking/select.ts — in selectTop skip any RankedStory with blockedUnlessOverride unless config.x.allowUnverifiedHighRisk; keep one-per-cluster, topN, minScore, sort by finalScore. FIX #7: when two items' finalScore are within a small epsilon, break the tie on r.item.engagementRaw?.views ?? 0 (higher first); RSS items (no engagementRaw) sort as 0 views — a stable no-op.

src/mastra/lib/ranking/prompt.ts — buildSystemPrompt gains the 8 new judgement field definitions and an X-mode note (for X items derive a factual derivedHeadline, judge isPrimarySource/isNewInformation, set flags; meaning only, no numbers). buildBatchPrompt adds a per-item isX / hasOutboundLink hint (meaning-only).

src/mastra/lib/ranking/fewshot.ts — FIX #14 (SAME edit as the schema change): add the 8 new fields to ALL 6 existing example score objects with sensible defaults (derivedHeadline = title, headlineDerived: true, isPrimarySource per source, flags all false, reasonable specificity/hookPotential, claimRisk 'low'). Add 3 SYNTHETIC X examples (good: fictional company shipping with an outbound link; medium: single-account claim; bad: giveaway/engagement-bait) with clearly fictional names (e.g. 'Nimbus Robotics', '@fakefounder'), no real facts, each tagged synthetic: true. Add synthetic?: boolean to FewShotExample.

tests/ranking/score.test.ts — update the 'perfect item' fixture to a maxed, cross-corroborated item (corroboration contributors present) and assert >= 90; add a comment that a maxed UNCORROBORATED RSS item caps at ~85 by design per FIX #5 and still clears minScore. Update any assertion tied to old weight numbers (e.g. the recency weightedContributions expectation) minimally.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` passes with the new config weights, schema fields, hard-filter branch, CorroborationContext, scoring restructure, select changes, and prompt/few-shot updates.
`npm run test` — tests/ranking/score.test.ts (updated), tests/ranking/hardFilter.test.ts, and tests/ranking/llmScore.test.ts all pass.
ranking weights still sum to exactly 10.0 and a fully-maxed X item yields qualityScore 100 (finalScore in [95,100]); a maxed uncorroborated RSS item caps at ~85.
A corroboration helper (urlKey/groupTextKey/matchOutboundToRss) is exported from rankStories.ts for FEAT-005's tests.
findings:
DONE. Verified: `npm run typecheck` exit 0; `npm run test` 88/88 pass (ranking score/hardFilter/llmScore all green); weights sum to EXACTLY 10.0 (asserted at runtime).

== config/ranking.config.ts ==
maxAgeHours = Math.min(envNum('RANK_MAX_AGE_HOURS',24),36) (default 24, env-raisable to 36); new field maxAgeCeilingHours=36. weights now: topicFit 2.0, significance 2.5, audienceInterest 1.5, visualPotential 1.0, recency 0.0, coverage 0.75, sourceCredibility 0.75, engagement 1.0 (NEW), corroboration 0.5 (NEW) — sum 10.0 EXACT. recencyHalfLifeHours kept (used by recencyScore unit test). NEW recencyTiebreaker { minMultiplier 0.95 (RANK_RECENCY_MIN_MULTIPLIER), maxMultiplier 1.0 (RANK_RECENCY_MAX_MULTIPLIER) }. NEW `x` block: minEngagementFloor 20, minTextLength 60, engagementRatioCap 3, neutralEngagementRatio 1, minSamplesForMedian 3, viewsBonusMax 0 (views break ties only), corroborationRssShare 0.6, corroborationMultiAccountShare 0.4, claimRiskHighPenalty 15, allowUnverifiedHighRisk (RANK_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_HIGH_RISK, default false). All env-overridable. Added envFlag helper.

== schemas/ranking.ts ==
LlmScoreSchema +8 REQUIRED fields: isNewInformation(bool), isPrimarySource(bool), specificity(0-10), hookPotential(0-10), claimRisk(enum low|medium|high), flags{engagementBait,selfPromotion,giveaway,hotTakeThread}, derivedHeadline(string<=200), headlineDerived(literal true).
ScoreComponentsSchema +fields: engagementComponent, engagementRatio, corroborationComponent, qualityScore, recencyMultiplier, recencyAdjustment.
RankedStorySchema +qualityScore(0-100) + optional derivedHeadline/hookPotential/claimRisk/verified/outboundUrls/quoted/attributionLine/blockedUnlessOverride.
RankInputItemSchema + optional X fields FEAT-004 must MAP from RawContent.metadata (keys postToRaw stamps -> RankInputItem field): isX?, isReply?, isRepost?, outboundUrls?:string[], quoted?:{text,author_handle:string|null,url,at}|null, authorHandle?(lowercased), engagementRaw?:{likes,reposts,replies,views}, accountMedianLikes?, accountMedianReposts?, accountStatus?:string (mapper defaults 'candidate'), isOfficialAccount?:boolean, accountCredibilityScore?:number, isPrimarySource?, claimRisk?, derivedHeadline?, hookPotential?.

== lib/ranking/rankStories.ts — EXPORTED corroboration helpers (for FEAT-005 corroboration.test.ts) ==
export urlKey(u) = normalizeUrl(u) then LOWERCASE host (FIX #4). export groupTextKey(text) = toLowerCase+NFKC+strip punct+first 12 tokens (FIX #3, shared/pure). export matchOutboundToRss(outboundUrls, rssUrlSet): full-urlKey OR host match. export corroborationGroupKey(item) = 'host:<firstOutboundHost>' else 'text:<groupTextKey(title+summary)>'. export buildCorroborationContext(kept): CorroborationContext { rssUrlSet:Set<string> (urlKey of every non-X item.url); credibleAccountsByGroup:Map<string,number> (distinct promoted authorHandles per group) }. Built AFTER Stage B, injected into every computeRankedStory via ScoreContext.corroboration. No gateway call. clusterId-equality corroboration branch DROPPED.

== lib/ranking/hardFilter.ts ==
New DROP_REASONS: X_IS_REPLY_OR_REPOST, X_BELOW_ENGAGEMENT_FLOOR, X_NO_SOURCE_SHORT. X branch (item.isX===true): drop reply/repost; drop if likes+reposts+replies < x.minEngagementFloor; drop if no outbound && max(summary,title) len < x.minTextLength; X skips SUMMARY_TOO_SHORT (blocklist still applies). too_old (config.maxAgeHours on publishedAt) stays SINGLE source of truth for the 24h drop, applied to X too. All RSS filters unchanged (NFR-3).

== lib/ranking/score.ts ==
qualityScore computed FIRST = clamp(Σ wᵢ·componentᵢ + regionBalanceAdjustment − penalties,0,100); finalScore = round2(qualityScore * recencyMultiplier). EXPORTED pure fns: relativeEngagement(item,config)->{ratio,component} (RSS->0; ratio clamp((likes+reposts+replies)/max(median,1),0,cap) when median>0 else neutralEngagementRatio; component ratio/cap*10 + at most viewsBonusMax/10 (default 0)); corroborationComponent(item,ctx,config)->0-10 (rssShare*10 on matchOutboundToRss + multiAccountShare*10 when credibleAccountsByGroup>=2); recencyMultiplierOf(publishedAt,now,config). verified = item.isOfficialAccount===true (read DIRECTLY, FIX #2) || isPrimarySource || outboundPointsToPrimary || corroboratedByRss. If (!verified && claimRisk==='high'): +x.claimRiskHighPenalty penalty 'unverifiedHighRisk' AND blockedUnlessOverride=true. FIX #5: maxed UNCORROBORATED RSS item caps ~85 (engagement 0, corroboration 0) — documented INTENTIONAL, NOT reweighted; still clears minScore 55.
ScoreContext now has optional `corroboration?: CorroborationContext`.

== lib/ranking/select.ts ==
selectTop skips any RankedStory.blockedUnlessOverride unless config.x.allowUnverifiedHighRisk; keeps one-per-cluster/topN/minScore. FIX #7 views tiebreak: when |Δ finalScore| <= 0.01, higher item.engagementRaw?.views (??0) wins; RSS sorts as 0 views (stable no-op).

== lib/ranking/prompt.ts + fewshot.ts ==
prompt: buildSystemPrompt documents all 8 new judgement fields + an X-MODE note (derive factual derivedHeadline, judge isPrimarySource/isNewInformation, set flags; meaning only, no numbers/handles). buildBatchPrompt adds per-X-item {isX:true, hasOutboundLink} hint (meaning-only).
fewshot: FewShotExample + optional `synthetic?:boolean`. ALL 6 existing examples updated with the 8 new fields in the SAME edit (FIX #14). Added 3 SYNTHETIC X examples (synthetic:true, fictional names @nimbus_robotics/Nimbus Robotics, @fakefounder/Vellum AI): good (first-party ship + outbound link), medium (single-account unverified funding claim, claimRisk high), bad (giveaway/engagement-bait).

== RankedStory / ScoreComponents FINAL field names (for FEAT-004 payload wiring) ==
RankedStory: item, llm, unscored, qualityScore, finalScore, components, weightedContributions, appliedPenalties, reason, derivedHeadline?, hookPotential?, claimRisk?, verified?, outboundUrls?, quoted?, attributionLine?, blockedUnlessOverride?.
ScoreComponents: topicFit, significance, audienceInterest, visualPotential, recencyScore, coverageScore, sourceCredibility, engagementComponent, engagementRatio, corroborationComponent, regionBalanceAdjustment, penalties, qualityScore, recencyMultiplier, recencyAdjustment.

== Tests ==
score.test.ts: perfect-item fixture -> maxed cross-corroborated X item asserting qualityScore 100 (source credibility pinned to 10 via config since the live registry caps at 9) & finalScore>=90 & verified; NEW test asserts maxed uncorroborated RSS caps ~85 (FIX #5). llm()/judged() helpers extended with the 8 new fields so safeParse stays green. hardFilter.test.ts 'drops items older than maxAgeHours' now uses a 30h item (default maxAge is 24h).

rawToRankItem mapper in lib/workflow/autoNewsToRas.ts was deliberately LEFT UNCHANGED (mapper X-field wiring is FEAT-004 scope).
